_meta.notes: DAMAGED SCAN - needs a human. Page 2 carries the 'Summary Page' heading and its page box ('Page 2 of 6 / HATCH / 9/15/6'), but the 7-line summary TABLE was never captured: the scanner fed two skewed Schedule A sheets over that page, so the whole table area is covered by itemized-contribution rows. Every totals field is therefore null (illegible/not present in the scan), NOT zero. The PDF itself is corrupt (pdftoppm xref errors, one page object null). I walked all 6 pages: p1 cover, p2 the damaged Summary Page, p3 = form 'Page 4 of 6' Schedule A, p4 = form 'Page 5 of 6' Schedule A, p5 and p6 are BOTH form 'Page 6 of 6' Schedule B (duplicated); the form's own page 3 of 6 is absent. For a human's reference only (NOT transcribed into totals): the Schedule A pages print 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED 7175-' and the Schedule B page prints 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE 1906-'. Neither amendment box is checked; the cover's Type-of-Report block uses the generic (undated) box labels, not the 2006 dated ones.
